questions.q: True or false? When the ala steps up to the ball, the fixo steps up too.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The ala slows the ball while the fixo covers behind.
choiceExplanations: If the fixo steps up too, one pass beats them both. The fixo stays behind to cover.
Right, it's false. The ala slows the ball while the fixo covers behind.

questions.q: Blue's pivot has the ball. Which picture keeps our goal safest?
options: Ala and fixo both stay back
questions.explain: Yes. The ala slows the ball, and the fixo covers behind to protect the goal.
choiceExplanations: Both players are at the ball, so one pass gets past them and nobody covers.
Nobody slows the ball here, so blue can run or shoot freely.
Yes. The ala slows the ball, and the fixo covers behind to protect the goal.

questions.q: Blue passes to the left wing. Our left ala steps up. Where does the fixo cover?
options: At the ball with the ala
questions.explain: Right. The fixo covers behind and inside, so a pass past the ala is not free.
choiceExplanations: That is far from the ball, so the left ala has no cover behind.
Right. The fixo covers behind and inside, so a pass past the ala is not free.
Now two players are at the ball, and nobody protects the space behind them.
